race.comment: HEADBANGER (3) resumes. She's a fast mare who won well over this trip easily at Cranbourne before a spell. Prior to that she'd been in the market in a strong 3yo race at Flemington and fresh here over the short course can see her very hard to run down. ARABELLA STAR (9) resumes. She mixed her form a bit last time in but ran a couple of good races last time in and should be steaming home. DIVINE DOT (6) ran well enough fresh in a bunched finish. Now out of 3yo company but can improve for the run and take beating. EGERTON (7) will be back but has produced some good runs at 1000m and can be running on strongly.
